trend: Founder story: why Mornings is 80 mg caffeine
why: Third-person founder story that explains a product choice with a number and ends with a question.
text:
Why 80 mg of caffeine and not 200? Our founder spent 10+ years in corporate and wanted a morning drink that didn't wreck his night.

A filter coffee can be 60 to 100 mg, so Mornings is roughly one small cup, paired with 200 mg L-theanine.

How many coffees are you at by 3 PM?
